name: delivery_book
description: Protected, two-step. Deliver a granted document to the registered address (next working day, morning or afternoon, KES 200), or book collection (method collect: free, no address needed, at Lango Square; passports only at the Konza Passport Desk). A passport is handed only to its holder.

application_id.description: application_id from application_submit on this call. Leave it out on a later call: the caller's newest granted application in the open service is used.

confirmation_id.description: Empty the first time; after the caller says yes, the confirmation_id you were given
